rows.evaluation_data: Submit the following for FAA review: - 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with their treating Endocrinologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam. It should include a summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); clinical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment and plan (prognosis); and follow-up. 2. Lab. Serum calcium, PTH, and urinary calcium performed no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam. 3. Imaging (X-ray or CT). Report from imaging study to evaluate for the presence of kidney stones no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam. 4. Results of any other testing already performed.
rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following for FAA review:

  • 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with their treating Endocrinologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam.

It should include a summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); clinical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment and plan (prognosis); and follow-up.

2. Lab. Serum calcium, PTH, and urinary calcium performed no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam.

3. Imaging (X-ray or CT). Report from imaging study to evaluate for the presence of kidney stones no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam.

4. Results of any other testing already performed.
